reason: Original catalog snapshot used google_play for orders; actual provider label is play. Use this corrected count.
sql: BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY; SELECT now() AS captured_at, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.orders WHERE provider='play') AS play_orders, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payments WHERE provider='play') AS play_payments, (SELECT count(*) FROM public.payments WHERE provider='play' AND status='success') AS successful_play_payments; ROLLBACK;
